body:
Your three bugs are fixed on branch worktree-cl12 (main merged in, 8 of 8 suites pass). Main can fast-forward to it (79babc0); I did not push main. The kit's own install (.kit/) is refreshed, so this repo's board runs the fixes.

## Text off screen (root cause, fixed once)
A flex or grid child keeps min-width:auto, so a long word or name pushes it out of its box. Each earlier fix was per component. Now one base rule covers every element, present and future. Your comment headers had their own cause: a popup-title rule (`h2 {flex:none}`) hit every ## in the orchestrator's comments. A train's name ran off the left (box wider than its scroll area). The "New below" pill floated outside the orchestrator panel on a desktop.
The guard: `kit/board/test_page_layout.js` (now in run_all_tests) fails when any text line runs off screen or is cut, at phone and desktop widths. Pictures: `docs/assets/cl12/before-02-phone-discussion.png` and `docs/assets/cl12/after-02-phone-discussion.png`.

## The badge that never cleared
A reply to the thread of your Like was hung under the Like, which is never drawn: never on screen, never seen. Your board has 2 such replies (22:01, 22:19). They now show under what you liked, and every unseen reply unfolds. A cleared badge stays cleared after a reload only once CL21 saves read marks.

## Done steps missing from the train view
The tasklist matched posts' train ("cli") against the group's display name, so only open steps matched. It now keys by train id.

## Also
Your sent / seen / answered marks each have their own word. A translated board no longer writes to a translated "posts/" path.

## docs/WHAT-NOT-TO-BREAK.md
Followed: origin/main (327aee3) merged in first; run_all_tests 8 of 8, no new failure; none of the listed load-bearing pieces touched (no change to prefixFor, the db wrap, build_artifact_page, kit.py, install.py, hooks, clerk); point 4: the ticks conflict resolved and test_artifact_repos.js and test_artifact_page.js pass on a page built from this branch.

## .kit/ copies
.kit/board.html, strings.py, strings.en.json and shim.js were older than kit/: refreshed with install --update. tests/test_kit_copies_current.py fails when they differ (2 of 2 fail on the old copies).

## Your 02:34 (words to the left, CL10's phone picture)
That picture was taken on main, which does not have this fix yet. On this branch, at 390, 411 (your phone) and 1300 px, nothing runs off screen or is cut, on the plain page and on the Artifact-built one, train tasklist included. The bar width and margins are CL10's.

## Lane tabs at 411 px (review)
The base rule let the four lane tabs shrink, so "Decisions" ran into its count. They now never get narrower than their label and the row scrolls sideways, as before. The layout check also fails when two texts in the same row overlap (8 fails on the previous commit, 0 now). Pictures: `docs/assets/cl12/before-411-lanes.png`, `docs/assets/cl12/after-411-lanes.png`.

title: Board UI: text never runs off screen, badge clears when seen, Done steps stay in the train view
verdict: Fixed all three: text overflow at the base layer with a browser check that fails on any cut text, the badge (hidden replies to a Like), and Done steps in the train view.
